about_the_game:
"Protean fox" is a thrilling yet lighthearted bullet-hell shooter where players take on the role of an adorable spirit fox. Wielding guns, enchanted artifacts, and magic, you'll battle diverse monsters across fantastical worlds, befriend pet companions, and seek the lost Spirit Fox Flame!

Join our Discord group to share your ideas and feedback—you might even design the next pet companion!

Battle Across Three Unique Worlds

Each world features distinct weapons, enemies, pets, and epic boss fights!

  • Ancient Fox Realm
    Explore mystical Eastern landscapes, wield enchanted artifacts, and uncover the origins of the spirit foxes.

  • Future Wasteland
    Fight mutated creatures with guns and modular tech in a post-apocalyptic world, searching for hope to save the future.

  • Fantasy Chronicles
    Enter a realm of magic and swordplay, ally with elves and vampires, and carve out your own legendary saga.

Three vastly different worlds await your exploration!

Collect and Evolve Pet Companions

Discover capturable pets in each level, train them to unlock powerful skills, and even recruit boss monsters to aid your journey!

Shape-Shifting Fox with Endless Possibilities

The little spirit fox can transform into multiple forms, each with unique playstyles. Combine different weapons and pets to create your ultimate combat style!

Master Diverse Weapons & Abilities

Weapons fall into three categories—Artifacts, Magic, and Firearms—each with complementary off-hand equipment:

  • Artifacts pair with Mechanisms

  • Firearms integrate Modules

  • Magic combines with Battle Skills

These combinations unlock endless combat possibilities! Additionally, as you progress, you’ll obtain random relics that enhance stats and introduce new gameplay twists.

Embark on an unforgettable adventure with your ever-changing fox—where every battle is a new challenge! 🦊✨

name: Protean fox demo
short_description: "Protean Fox" is a bullet shooting game that combines elements of creature capture and light roguelike gameplay. Players will take on the role of a girl who gains the power of the Protean Fox. In her quest to reclaim the Foxfire, she wields weapons and magical artifacts from different worlds。

English, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Korean
*languages with full audio support
